items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: And of course we made that record with Joe Farrell, one of his flutists, but then he died.

ctx.x: He’s always liked jazz flute, hasn’t he?
Right. And of course we made that record with Joe Farrell, one of his flutists, but then he died.
Yeah. That was a shame. I know you’ve recorded with, oh Sam Noto, look at that.
